scope.oraclePolicy: Use project-defined contracts, operation logs, snapshots, diffs, validator reports, GUI semantic evidence, rights/provenance metadata, and demo-safe preflight only. Do not use external proprietary format, SDK/Core, viewer matching, physics compatibility, or existing third-party model oracles.

included: Current or Accepted Private Prototype scenario files
Minimum Open Dynamics v1 current MVP scenario
activeScenarioPolicy.excludedReason: Optional or Future-only scenarios are not P0 gates unless the source file explicitly marks a current private fixture or hygiene boundary.

tests.title: GUI authoring entrance evidence
tests.oracle: GUI semantic evidence and committed operation log prove the package was authored through the private GUI workflow.

tests.title: Layered character import and provenance
tests.oracle: layered-character-psd-profile-v1, package DTO schemas, and rights/provenance checks.

tests.title: Missing rights and provenance rejection
tests.oracle: Validator must emit rights.provenanceMissing or equivalent blocking rights/provenance diagnostic.

tests.title: Project-defined package round trip
tests.oracle: Project-defined package layout, stable IDs, package hash, and runtime snapshot equivalence.

tests.title: Unsupported input boundary
tests.oracle: Concept and MVP AC require project-defined inputs only; unsupported proprietary/runtime paths must not become load, inspect, convert, or migration oracles.

tests.title: Drawable part texture references
tests.oracle: Package graph, drawable, texture, and part references resolve through stable IDs.

tests.title: Mesh edit changes runtime state
tests.oracle: Mesh DTO and runtime vertex hash change under declared epsilon without blocking diagnostics.

tests.title: Invalid mesh diagnostics
tests.oracle: Validator must report triangle index or degenerate triangle diagnostics against mesh targets.

tests.title: Composition mask and draw order
tests.oracle: Runtime snapshot and mask diagnostics distinguish editor-only state from runtime-visible composition state.

tests.title: Parameter range alias and semantic role
tests.oracle: Parameter DTO preserves range, default, current value, semantic role, and project preset alias.

tests.title: Keyform interpolation sequence
tests.oracle: Runtime keyform interpolation and multi-parameter effective state match package semantics within epsilon.

tests.title: Manual two-axis face grid
tests.oracle: parameter-grid-2d-v1 evaluator and declared epsilon produce deterministic manual face grid snapshots.

tests.title: Invalid keyform diagnostics
tests.oracle: Validator must classify missing endpoint or invalid grid keyform evidence by target keyform ID.

tests.title: Warp rig control binding
tests.oracle: Rig control target graph, parameter binding, and evaluated drawable state are present in operation log and snapshot.

tests.title: Rotation hierarchy evaluation
tests.oracle: Parent-before-child runtime evaluation order and child drawable bounds/hash change are deterministic.

tests.title: Rig hierarchy cycle rejection
tests.oracle: Validator rejects rig control hierarchy cycles and produces no successful topological evaluation order.

tests.title: Face expression authoring
tests.oracle: Project-defined face parameters change drawable state and remain observable through GUI evidence and runtime snapshots.

tests.title: Body posture and joint area authoring
tests.oracle: Body and joint-area authoring evidence proves editable posture and seam-risk reporting without treating joint areas as runtime solvers.

tests.title: Minimum dynamics group authoring
tests.oracle: Minimum Open Dynamics v1 package contract: authored drivers, one computed output parameter per group, fixed settings, reset policy.

tests.title: Deterministic dynamics preview and viewer sequence
tests.oracle: scalarDampedFollowV1, explicit RuntimeStateDto, fixed timestep, input frame hash, and epsilon policy produce repeatable sequence evidence.

tests.title: Fixed-step RuntimeState replay evidence
tests.oracle: Runtime state sequence must have states[0] initial and states[i+1] post-frame semantics with no state length or timestep mismatch.

tests.title: Dynamics missing driver diagnostic
tests.oracle: Formal validator diagnostic `dynamics.driverMissing` identifies a dynamics group without a valid authored driver.

tests.title: Dynamics missing output diagnostic
tests.oracle: Formal validator diagnostic `dynamics.outputMissing` identifies a dynamics group without a computed output parameter.

tests.title: Dynamics duplicate output target diagnostic
tests.oracle: Formal validator diagnostic `dynamics.outputTargetDuplicate` identifies duplicate producers for the same computed output parameter.

tests.title: Dynamics output range clamp diagnostic
tests.oracle: Formal diagnostics `dynamics.outputParameterOutOfRange` and `dynamics.outputClamped` plus runtime diff evidence prove clamp behavior without external physics matching.

tests.title: Dynamics cycle and computed-driver diagnostic
tests.oracle: Formal diagnostics `dynamics.outputUsedAsDriver` and `dynamics.groupCycle` cover only computed-output-as-driver and group dependency cycles.

tests.title: Keyform grid invalid diagnostics
tests.oracle: Formal diagnostics `keyform.grid2dMissingKey` and `keyform.grid2dDuplicateKey` identify invalid two-axis grid coordinates.

tests.title: Runtime load blocking diagnostic
tests.oracle: Formal diagnostic `runtime.loadBlocking` proves a normalized graph that cannot produce deterministic runtime output fails before viewer acceptance.

tests.title: AI dry-run mutation rejection
tests.oracle: Formal diagnostic `ai.dryRunMutatedPackage` and unchanged package revision prove AI dry-run did not cross the approval boundary.

tests.title: AI dry-run out-of-range parameter clamp
tests.oracle: Formal diagnostic `runtime.parameterClamped`, runtime diff evidence, and dry-run no-commit evidence prove out-of-range AI input stays reviewable.

tests.title: AI screenshot-assisted semantic target selection
tests.oracle: Semantic GUI evidence and AI command transcript identify stable `rigControl` and parameter targets before any dry-run edit; screenshot pixels are supplemental only.

tests.title: Demo-safe viewer capture artifact
tests.oracle: Demo preflight report and allowed capture state prove viewer capture exposes only approved scene, disclaimer, and high-level controls.

tests.title: Demo unsafe forbidden dependency wording
tests.oracle: Formal diagnostic `demo.unsafeDependencyClaim` and demo preflight evidence reject forbidden format, SDK/Core, viewer matching, or physics compatibility claims as public-surface wording.

tests.title: Dynamics demo-safe capture
tests.oracle: Demo-safe preflight permits high-level secondary motion output while hiding internal solver and package details.

tests.title: Runtime load and non-empty renderer input
tests.oracle: Runtime snapshot and renderer input prove non-empty project-defined model display without hidden mutable dynamics state.

tests.title: Viewer parameter operation and validation display
tests.oracle: Viewer state exposes parameter ranges/current values and links snapshot diagnostics to the validation report.

tests.title: Validator schema asset and runtime checks
tests.oracle: Validator check registry and report schema classify package schema, asset reference, mesh/runtime, and report evidence.

tests.title: Verification diff and acceptance judgment
tests.oracle: Acceptance runner aggregates model structure, runtime state, validation report, and diffs into pass/fail/needs_review evidence.

tests.title: AI inspect and validation report read
tests.oracle: AI command contract returns structured observations and report references without mutating the package.

tests.title: AI dry-run repair candidate
tests.oracle: Dry-run must leave package revision unchanged until approved and link repair candidate to validation evidence.

tests.title: AI provenance and demo-safe support
tests.oracle: AI assistance can classify provenance/demo-safe issues through structured reports and dry-run metadata repair.

tests.title: AI operation audit log
tests.oracle: Operation log distinguishes human and AI-assisted actions and records approval/provenance boundaries.

tests.title: GUI semantic hit-test evidence
tests.oracle: GUI tests use stable semantic target IDs and operation payloads, not raw pixels, as primary evidence.

tests.title: Private rights-clean fixture policy
tests.oracle: Private fixtures must be rights-clean, provenance-linked, and not depend on external proprietary samples.

tests.title: Demo-safe preflight
tests.oracle: Demo-safe preflight separates private implementation details from the streaming/demo surface and checks rights visibility.

tests.title: Hygiene proposal and future subset boundary
tests.oracle: Proposal and future-public materials must stay separate from MVP private implementation and avoid compatibility or internal-schema claims.

tests.title: Discussion baseline restoration
tests.oracle: Discussion docs must restore the current Private Prototype baseline, MVP boundaries, and traceable source paths.

tests.title: Nondependency guardrail scan
tests.oracle: MVP success cannot depend on external proprietary formats, SDK/Core, viewer matching, physics compatibility, or existing third-party models.

tests.title: Script-only package cannot satisfy MVP
tests.oracle: A package with no GUI operation log or GUI evidence cannot satisfy the MVP even if runtime load succeeds.

tests.title: Traceability lint
tests.oracle: Every P0 test entry has fixture, operation flow, artifact, oracle, automation, gate, owner module, and no machine-readable ID spaces.

remainingIssues: Fixture files and expected artifacts are planned only; this deliverable does not create fixture packages or runner outputs.
Exact visual-review thresholds remain hybrid/manual until capture and semantic snapshot runners exist.
Optional/Future-only scenarios are intentionally excluded from P0 gates and should be reintroduced only after scope is reopened.
